name: Weave
sub: Cloth built as cloth: warp and weft at their own counts, a real interlacing, slubbed and hairy threads, every float a raised body lit by the sheet light and casting into the gaps. A cut edge frays thread by thread. FX-01 and FX-02 can print onto it.

in.o: params object — keys below; every length in CSS px
in.dpr: device px per CSS px (density is physical: marks per CSS px²)

x.S: params of every effect keyed by id; the stock this prints on is read from S[printsOn]
x.umask: optional: clips.umask — a typed or image mask (mShape type | image)

out.lin: Float32Array W·H·3, linear-light sRGB (encode with FX.toRGBA(R,"image",W,H))
out.ink: Float32Array W·H, absorbance / coverage (FX.toRGBA(R,"ink",…) = film positive)
out.stock: Float32Array W·H, stock height (FX.toRGBA(R,"stock",…) = normalized height map)

light.note: az = direction the light comes FROM (screen degrees; 0 = right, 90 = below); el = elevation above the sheet

deterministic: yes — every random draw is a hash of (position, seed); same inputs → same pixels in the same engine

recipe: Warp columns and weft rows at their own counts (threads / 100 CSS px); each thread: jittered center, thickness, dye-lot L, fray length, accent.

Interlacing decides the top thread per crossing; a float is the run where it stays on top. Height = cylinder across the thread × arch along the float; under-threads sit low; hair = fine noise along the thread.
Albedo in OKLab: under-thread, then top thread by AA coverage; accent as flecks (single floats, as in the source) or whole threads.
Light: Lambert from the height gradient + a height-field shadow march toward the sheet light, so floats shade into the gaps; ambient occlusion darkens the gaps.
Cut: the mask's signed distance plus each thread's own fray length — threads end raggedly, not on a line. The swatch casts onto the page.

limits.what: threads under 2 CSS px alias against a 1× display — moiré (fine on 2×/3×)
threads over ~5 px read as a woven-texture graphic, not cloth
reads as a grid of strokes, not cloth
gutters close; the weave flattens to a check
